_why: The project's routines: scheduled work run by .claude/routines.sh on this machine, while no one is at it. Each routine is a time (HH:MM, <days> HH:MM, every <N>m|h) and either a shell command or a claude -p run with a role, read-only tools and a turn limit. The runner is routines.sh: .claude/routines.sh in a project the model is installed in, or routines.sh at the root of the clauductor plugin. Run `routines.sh setup --billing subscription|api` once before adding a claude -p routine; `routines.sh validate` checks this file, and docs/playbook.md (Routines) says the rest.
